name: Chao bo cau
summary: Cháo bồ câu is a late porridge of pigeon simmered whole, with lotus seeds or mung beans. Nghệ An chili powder goes on, and the rice blooms without turning to mush.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page puts the bowl at the end of the day. The 4 September 2016 page describes the pot.
howToEat: Order it before you stop for the night. Ask for lotus seeds or mung beans on the city page. The 2016 page adds chili powder and says the rice grains open without collapsing. That article printed about 70,000 đồng a bowl. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress, 4 September 2016, names Phan Chu Trinh. A shop on that street is not a pick. The hour is Check on arrival.
